items.problem: CS0103: The name 'Colors' does not exist in the current context after the namespace rewrite.
items.evidence: Migration session-log build errors on scenario files; agent fixed by adding the color namespace using/qualifier.
items.covered_clearly_at: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md namespace mapping table row: `| Windows.UI.Colors | Microsoft.UI.Colors |` (the exact type is listed).
items.why_no_skill_change: The type is explicitly in the mapping table; a capable model would consult it and qualify/using the color namespace. Adding more prose about one already-tabulated type would just bloat the mapping.

items.problem: Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 first run FAILED because MIGRATION-MAPPING rows were still Status=copied.
items.evidence: Migration session-log ~turn 68 FAIL; agent flipped rows copied->done and re-ran to PASS (~turn 71).
items.covered_clearly_at: SKILL.md Step 3: 'Flip `Status` from `copied` -> `done` (or `deferred`) as each row is finished.' and Step 4 diagnostic: 'Status = copied rows -> those files were never finished. Either complete the migration and flip to done ...'
items.why_no_skill_change: The Status lifecycle is stated prominently in both the walk-the-rows step and the validation-failure playbook. A re-run that follows the documented per-file flip would not hit this. Fixing a slip here would mean 'tell the model to read', which is noise.
